doc.title: Billy Bauer interviewed by Monk Rowe, New York City, New York, March 22, 1998

title: Banjo teachers, learning to read, and what a note is
summary: Two banjo teachers made him read music; he now asks students what a note is, answering that it is a set of regular vibrations with four elements.

story.theme_name: Growing up and learning music: family, first instruments, teachers
story.community_name: Learning your horn: teachers, lessons and fees

blocks.x: But did it ever get to the point where all of a sudden your father was saying now wait a minute, this music stuff is okay for fun—

Oh yeah, yeah. Well then after he got me the banjo, then he got me a teacher in a candy store. The guy owned a candy store and I’d go back there and he’d show me. But he did do one thing. I had two banjo teachers. And they at least tried to make you learn how to read music. You know it wasn’t like C or nothing like that, it was written out and you had to learn where everything is. Now they have all the, like Harry Reser’s, he was a popular band leader, Cliquot Eskimos I think they were called. Harry Reser, he played like a violin player would play, you know, those banjo solos. So I had that environment, which I try to tell these kids that helped me out because at least I saw music in front of me. Where some of them now, they just see G seventh, and then — well now they’re coming to me, they come to me and they say what’s that called, what’s that called. Oh what’s a flat nine, what’s a — I says wait a minute. Flat nine. I says you know the old Italian guy, he comes in, he’s sitting on his porch, he’s just got done playing with the grapes all day long, his hands are all cut and callused. And he sits on his porch, he has his bottle of wine there, and he drinks a couple of wines and he picks up his guitar and he goes [scats]. If you can’t do that, forget it. You know what I mean? Like make it that everybody’s dancing and singing music. You know what I mean? You know what the first question I ask them after they get all through telling me they played with this Rock group and that group. I says you want to learn how to read? They say yeah, that’s why I came, I want you to, I heard that you make me read. I says well what’s a note? You don’t want me to ask you.
What’s a note. Well it’s a duration of sound.

Well that’s close. But they either say it’s a pitch or something like that. What it is is a set of regular vibrations. A musical note. See if it isn’t set, it isn’t musical. And that goes, and it has four elements. So I says that’s all I talk about. When you’re talking and playing for me, I’m picking your weakest one and I’m showing you what your weaknesses are.
